# Junto Technologies

> Junto Technologies builds software for chemistry labs. It also applies machine learning and statistics to biomedical questions.

## Projects

- [ChemInventory](https://cheminventory.co/): Inventory software that fits how each lab works. One record of what a lab holds, where it is and who changed it.
- [Bench Bridge](https://bench-bridge.juntotechnologies.com/): A demo of how older lab instruments can feed a laboratory information management system (LIMS) and a controlled-substance ledger.

## Open source

- [dcurves](https://github.com/MSKCC-Epi-Bio/dcurves): A Python package for decision curve analysis. The method evaluates and compares prediction models and diagnostic tests by their clinical consequences.
- [bioeq](https://github.com/juntotechnologies/bioeq): A Python package for bioequivalence analysis. It handles 2x2 crossover, parallel and replicate designs.
- [hct-equity](https://github.com/juntotechnologies/hct-equity): Models that compare survival predictions across race groups, with calibration and decision curve analysis. It uses synthetic data from a Kaggle competition. It is not peer reviewed.
